_comment: ADR-037 register fragment for openspec/changes/automation-job-calendar-schedules (REQ-JCAL-001). Adds a `schedule` object to the `job` schema: `type` `interval` (the default; today's behaviour, reading `interval`) or `calendar`, and for a calendar the ISO weekdays (1 is Monday), an optional day-of-month rule, one or more HH:MM times, an IANA time zone and dates to skip. An absent `schedule` means `interval`, so every existing job keeps its behaviour. `scheduleFingerprint` is written by JobService next to `nextRun`: a hash of the schedule the next run was computed from, so an edited calendar is noticed on the next tick (design D3). No `version` here on purpose: fragments merge in file-name order and learniq-exchange-jobs.json, which sorts after this file, sets the job schema's version last, so a bump here would be overwritten; the import's content-differs path picks the new properties up.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: When the job runs: every `interval` seconds, or on a calendar of weekdays, a day-of-month rule and times of day in a time zone. Absent means interval.

weekdays.title: Weekdays
weekdays.description: ISO weekday numbers: 1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday.

dayOfMonth.title: Day of month
dayOfMonth.description: Optional. A working day is Monday to Friday minus the skipped dates. A day number the month does not have skips that month.

times.title: Times of day
times.description: HH:MM in the calendar's time zone.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: An IANA time zone such as Europe/Amsterdam.

scheduleFingerprint.title: Schedule fingerprint
scheduleFingerprint.description: Set by the run loop: a hash of the calendar the next run was computed from.
